supports: Keeping costs down for New Yorkers
Action against online platforms that raise costs on customers
positions.quote: She is laser-focused on keeping costs down for New Yorkers, including from online platforms that would try to raise costs on their customers.

source.title: Priorities | Letitia James for New York (campaign site)

positions.impact: Expect continued consumer-protection cases against companies accused of unfair pricing. The Attorney General enforces these laws but doesn't set taxes or prices.

supports: Recovering money from companies that harmed New Yorkers' access to health care, such as opioid makers and nursing homes
positions.quote: Letitia has secured billions of dollars from individuals and corporations who have taken advantage of New Yorkers and tried to deprive them of their health care access, including more than $3 billion from opioid manufacturers and distributors for their roles in the deadly opioid epidemic and more than $70 million in settlements from neglectful nursing homes.

source.title: Priorities | Letitia James for New York (campaign site)

positions.impact: Expect more lawsuits and settlements against health care companies and providers accused of wrongdoing. Settlement money is often directed to programs such as opioid treatment.

supports: Legal action to protect immigrants against federal immigration enforcement she calls illegal
positions.quote: Letitia has led the fight to protect immigrants in New York and across the country against the Trump administration’s chaotic and illegal immigration activities.

source.title: Priorities | Letitia James for New York (campaign site)

positions.impact: The state would likely keep suing the federal government over immigration enforcement actions. Outcomes would depend on the courts.

supports: Action against gun violence, illegal firearms and ghost guns
positions.quote: Letitia is working tirelessly to protect New Yorkers from gun violence, illegal firearms and ghost guns.

source.title: Priorities | Letitia James for New York (campaign site)

positions.impact: Expect continued enforcement and lawsuits targeting illegal gun sales and untraceable ghost guns. Day-to-day policing stays with local police and district attorneys.

supports: Fair wages and access to good-paying jobs
Protecting the rights of union workers
positions.quote: Letitia is fighting for New Yorkers to have fair wages and access to good-paying jobs, while protecting the men and women of organized labor.

source.title: Priorities | Letitia James for New York (campaign site)

positions.impact: Expect continued wage-theft and labor-law cases against employers. The Attorney General enforces wage laws but doesn't set the minimum wage.
